G10_direction_transparency.definition: bullish and bearish results reported separately

G1_pit_integrity.definition: PIT recomputation reproduces every feature and every signal survives bar truncation

G2_data_quality.definition: no missing session days, no OHLC violations, sessions flagged

G3_oos_expectancy.definition: OOS expectancy > 0 in points and R; block-bootstrap p <= 0.10

G4_sample_sufficiency.definition: >=8 OOS trades, >=3 per direction, >=2 distinct weeks

G5_robustness.definition: >=2/3 splits positive, >=4/6 WF blocks positive, >=70% positive parameter neighbours

G6_risk_shape.definition: IS+VAL maxDD <= 3R; no single loss worse than -1.2R

G7_concentration.definition: best trade <=40% of OOS profit and expectancy positive without the best trade

G8_cost_robustness.definition: OOS expectancy > 0 at the 0.10R proxy cost

G9_no_trade_mechanism.definition: closed NO TRADE reason taxonomy, reported per model
